# Tony Does Design

> Tony Does Design is a Philadelphia brand identity and creative strategy studio run by Tony Perez. It builds strategy-first brand identities, brand systems and websites for businesses that have outgrown their first logo, through defined one-off projects. Ongoing design support for brands that already exist is offered separately by NineFive Design Co., a monthly subscription studio.

Tony has 12+ years of design experience, including design systems for a utility serving 500,000+ customers and go-to-market visual strategy for an AI-powered SaaS platform. He holds a bachelor's in Multimedia Design and a master's in Human Factors Psychology, and designs around how people perceive, remember and decide.

Which to choose: starting or repositioning a brand → a Tony Does Design package. Already have a brand and need ongoing creative work → NineFive Design Co.

## Brand projects (Tony Does Design)

- [Brand Sprint](https://www.tonydoesdesign.com/#services): from $2,500, 2 weeks. Logo mark and wordmark, colour and type system, brand usage guidelines, 3 social templates.
- [Brand Identity System](https://www.tonydoesdesign.com/#services): from $6,500, 4–6 weeks. Brand strategy and positioning, full identity system, detailed guidelines, digital and print asset library, 30 days of post-launch support.
- [Brand + Digital](https://www.tonydoesdesign.com/#services): from $10,000, 6–8 weeks. Full brand identity system, website design and build, strategy and positioning, digital asset library and social templates, 45 days of post-launch support.
- [Process](https://www.tonydoesdesign.com/#process): every project runs in five phases: discovery, strategy, design, production, handoff and launch.

## Ongoing design (NineFive Design Co.)

- [NineFive Design Subscription](https://www.ninefivedesign.com/): $997 per month. One active request at a time from a queue the client prioritises, 48-hour average turnaround per standard request, larger work delivered in agreed stages, pause or cancel anytime. Intended for businesses that already have a brand.

## Selected work

- [Philadelphia Gas Works](https://www.tonydoesdesign.com/work/pgw-bill-redesign/): UX · Service design. A utility bill 500,000+ customers can actually read.
- [OrbitCoat Painting](https://www.tonydoesdesign.com/work/orbitcoat-painting/): Brand identity. A retro-inspired identity for a Florida painter known for its service.
- [LVMNY (Love Money)](https://www.tonydoesdesign.com/work/lvmny/): Streetwear · Graphic design. Streetwear graphics, including two designs that are still best sellers.
- [Black Paranoia](https://www.tonydoesdesign.com/work/black-paranoia/): Streetwear · Collection design. Case File 3PK, a surveillance-era streetwear drop from Baltimore.
- [PS & Co.](https://www.tonydoesdesign.com/work/ps-and-co/): Identity · Website. Our family's small-batch body care brand, from logo to online store.

## Live websites

- [Kaiju Combat Sports](https://www.kaijucombatsports.com): Muay Thai, boxing and jiu-jitsu gym in South Philadelphia. Class schedule, coaches and trial-week booking.
- [JNC Builders & Design](https://www.jncbuild.com): Philadelphia general contractor. Residential and commercial construction, remodeling and permit services.
- [The Beauty Secrets](https://www.thebeautysecretsllc.com): Cosmetic studio in Philadelphia. Makeup, brows, lash lifts and permanent makeup with online booking.
- [Trucking Hungry](https://www.truckinghungry.com): Microsite platform for food trucks: live location, menu, hours and tap-to-call for $25 a month.
- [PS & Co.](https://ps-and-co.vercel.app): Online store for small-batch soaps, candles, body care and spa services, with cart and checkout.
- [Royal Striking MMA](https://royalstriking.com): Martial arts gym in Philadelphia. Muay Thai, jiu-jitsu, boxing and strength classes, a trial offer and a member portal.
- [NineFive Design Co.](https://www.ninefivedesign.com/): Subscription design studio. Ongoing creative for brands that already exist.
